name: SALA Corporation
summary: SALA Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the energy supply and solution business in Japan. The company operates through Energy & Solutions Business, Engineering & Maintenance Business, Housing Business, Car Life Support Business, Animal Health Care Business, and Property Business segments. It provides natural gas and LP gas/petroleum products; sells heat and electricity; and generates biomass power, as well as engages in the transportation of gas and petroleum, and delivery services for private homes.
